items.label: Cipher Digital press release: Cipher Digital Expands Barber Lake Lease Term to 20 Years, (09-25-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Cipher Digital extended the contracted lease duration of its

set.signal: Cipher Digital extended the contracted lease duration of its Barber Lake data center (Colorado City, Texas) from 10 years to 20 years, raising total contracted revenue at the facility from $3.8 billion to over $9 billion: an amendment to the existing Barber Lake Lease with Fluidstack is coupled with a binding commitment from an unnamed 'leading AI lab' to lease the facility for an additional 10-year term after the Fluidstack lease ends, under a separate lease with substantially consistent economics, expected to generate approximately $5.2 billion of incremental contracted revenue. CEO Tyler Page: 'We believe this transaction underscores the quality and enduring strength of our sites, as well as the durability of demand for hyperscale computing capacity'.

items.reason: CEO quote paraphrase dropped the hedge 'We believe'; restore the attributed statement with its hedge.
items.evidence: "We believe this transaction underscores the quality and enduring strength of our sites, as well as the durability of demand for hyperscale computing capacity."

items.label: NetApp press release: NetApp Announces Intent to Acquire PEAK:AIO to Advance (09-25-2026)
items.signal_prefix: NetApp announced its intent to acquire PEAK:AIO, a developer

set.signal: NetApp announced its intent to acquire PEAK:AIO, a developer of metadata architecture and high-performance parallel file systems, to augment metadata services and parallel namespace innovation in its ONTAP-based architecture for AI clouds scaling shared storage alongside growing GPU clusters. The combined architecture disaggregates metadata from data, adds a global namespace and parallel NFS-based access, and is intended to support trillions of files and multi-exabyte deployments and to help reduce data-related GPU stalls. CEO George Kurian: 'AI clouds need high-performance shared storage that can scale alongside growing GPU clusters'. The transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals; NetApp states it makes no commitment and has no obligation to develop or deliver any products, integrations or features resulting from the acquisition.

items.reason: Release disclaims any commitment to develop or deliver resulting products at all, not only their timing.
items.evidence: NetApp makes no commitment and has no obligation to develop or deliver any products, services, integrations, or any related features ... including any capabilities resulting from the acquisition of PEAK:AIO.

items.label: Onto Innovation press release: Onto Innovation Completes Strategic Investment in Rigaku (08-10-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Partner Rigaku: Onto Innovation closed its acquisition of a

set.signal: Partner Rigaku: Onto Innovation closed its acquisition of a 27% minority equity stake in Rigaku Holdings Corporation, deepening the strategic collaboration first announced in April 2026 to advance X-ray technologies for emerging semiconductor manufacturing process-control applications. CEO Mike Plisinski cited growing process-control challenges from more complex 3D architectures and exotic materials and said 'We are excited by the initial success of our collaboration'.

items.reason: Accounting treatment and board-nomination sentence is governance / investment accounting, not an operating fact (skill section 2); drop it, keep the stake and collaboration facts.
items.evidence: Onto Innovation will account for the investment under the fair value option method and will not consolidate Rigaku's financial results. Onto Innovation will nominate a director to serve on Rigaku's board.

items.label: Sandisk press release: Sandisk Details Growth Strategy and Long-Term Financial (08-13-2026)
items.signal_prefix: At its 2026 Investor Day Sandisk introduced a financial mode

set.signal: At its 2026 Investor Day Sandisk introduced a financial model for fiscal 2028 through fiscal 2030: revenue expected to grow mid-to-high teens, consistent with bit growth; non-GAAP gross margin sustained at approximately 80 percent; non-GAAP operating margin approximately 75 percent, assuming operating expenses around five percent of revenue; adjusted free cash flow margin approximately 50 percent after taxes, capital expenses and working capital. CFO Luis Visoso said confidence in the model comes from the multi-year NBMs.

items.reason: Capital-return policy (returning excess cash to shareholders) is a shareholder-return / financing item not captured under skill section 2; keep the operating financial model.
items.evidence: we expect to return 100 percent of excess cash to our shareholders after investing in the business.
